senses.gloss:
f. (-यी)
1 A goddess, the wife of AGNI, the deity of fire, and presiding over prayers accompanied with burnt offerings.
2 The Tretā or second age of the Hindus.
E.
अग्नि fire, and fem. aff. ङीप्^1, with आय substituted for ऐ inserted.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312. note: missing virAma.

m. (-ग्निः)
1 Fire, always associated with the idea of the deity presiding over it, and who is worshipped by the Hindus. AGNI is also regent of the south-east quarter.
2 A consecrated fire.
3 The fire of the stomach, the digestive faculty, appetite.
4 Bile.
5 Gold.
6 A plant of which the fruit has escharotic properties, (Semecarpus anacardium.)
7 Another plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
E.
अङ्ग to mark, and नि Uṇādi aff, ङ being dropped.

m. (-कः)
An insect of a scarlet color, the lady-bird.
E.
अग्नि fire, and क aff. resembling fire.

m. (-णः)
A spark.
E.
अग्नि fire, and कण a small particle.

f. (-का)
Maintaining a sacrificial fire, &c.
E.
अग्नि fire, and कारिका making, from कृ to do.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Caused by fire.
E.
अग्नि and कारित caused.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Maintaining a sacred fire.
E.
अग्नि and कार्य्य act.

n. (-ष्ठं)
Agallochum. See अगुरु.
E.
अग्नि fire, and काष्ठ wood.

m. (-टः)
A firebrand, a lighted wisp of straw.
E.
अग्नि fire, and कुक्कुट a wisp of lighted straw.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done with or made by fire, offered with fire.
E.
अग्नि and कृत done.

m. (-णः)
The east.
E.
अग्नि and कोण corner.

f. (-डा)
Illuminations, fireworks, &c.
E.
अग्नि and क्रीडा play

m. (-र्भः)
1 The sun-stone, crystal, or a fabulous gem; supposed to contain and impart solar heat.
2 A plant.
f. (-र्भा)
The name of another plant.
E.
अग्नि and गर्भ the womb.

m. (-चित्)
A householder who has placed and consecrated a sacrificial fire.
E.
अग्नि fire, and चित् who collects.

f. (-त्या)
Maintaining a sacred fire.
E.
अग्नि and चित्या collecting.

m. (-जः)
A plant used in medicine, of stimulant properties.
mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Produced by or producing fire, also अग्निजात.
2 Digestive.
E.
अग्रि fire, and ज who or what is born, from जन.

m. (-रः)
A medicinal plant. See अग्निज.

m. (-लः)
A medicinal plant. See अग्निज.

f. (-ह्वा)
1 A medicinal plant. See लाङ्गलिकी.
2 A flame of fire.
E.
अग्नि, and जिह्वा the tongue, growing like a flame of fire.

f. (-ला)
1 A flame of fire.
2 A plant bearing red blossoms used by dyers, (Grislea tomentosa, Rox.)
3 Another plant, commonly Jalapippalī.
E.
अग्नि and ज्वाला flame, from the fiery colour of its blossoms.

f. (-ता)
The aggregate of the three fires maintained by the Brahman householder, the Gārhapatya or domestic, Ahavanīya or consecrated, and Dakṣiṇa or southern.
E.
अग्नि and त्रेता triad.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Setting on fire, incendiary.
2 Supplying with fire.
3 Stomachic, tonic, digestive.
E.
अग्नि and द what gives.

f. (-नी)
A medicinal plant, of narcotic properties, (Solanum jacquini.) See कण्ठकारिका.
E.
अग्रि bile, and दमनी what tames.

m. (-ग्धः)
A Pitṛ or progenitor to whom oblations are made.
mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Burnt.
E.
अग्नि and दग्ध burnt.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Blazing, on fire.
2 Digestive.
f. (-प्ता)
The name of a plant.
E.
अग्नि and दीप्त inflamed.

m. (-वः)
1 AGNI, the god of fire.
2 A worshipper of fire.
f. (-वा)
A name of the third lunar mansion, identified with the Pleiades: AGNI being the ruling deity of the constellation, Also अग्निदेवता.

n. (-त्यं)
The supremacy or divinity of fire.
E.
अग्नि and दैवत्य divinity.

m. (-सः)
The name of a plant, also अग्निजार.
E.
अग्नि and निर्य्यास decoction or extract.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
Cooked or dressed with fire.
E.
अग्नि and पक्क mature.

n. (-दं)
The implements and apparatus used in oblations to fire.
E.
अग्नि and परिच्छद accompaniments.

f. (-क्षा)
The fiery ordeal, by a heated iron or boiling oil, or passing through fire.
E.
अग्नि and परीक्षा trial.

m. (-रः)
Fire-stone, flint, or any stone producing fire.
E.
अग्नि and प्रस्तर a stone.

m. (-भः)
Gold.
E.
अग्नि and भ for भा lustre, brilliant as fire.

m. (-भूः)
A name of SKANDA, the Hindu deity of war. See कार्त्तिकेय and स्कन्द.
E.
अग्नि and भू being; being, or born, from fire. ŚIVA having cast his seed into flame, for the purpose of generating a warrior, able to subdue TĀRAKA, a demon, SKANDA was produced.
n. (-भु)
Water, which is generated, in the Hindu cosmogony, from fire.

m. (-तिः)
A proper name. One of the pupils of the last Jaina saint.
E.
अग्नि and भूति superhuman power: equal to AGNI.

m. (-णिः)
The sun-stone.
E.
अग्नि and मणि a jewel or gem, brilliant as fire.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत)
1 Having a consecrated fire.
2 Having fire in general.
E.
अग्नि and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-न्यः)
A small tree, (Premna spinosa.)
E.
अग्नि and मन्य churning, because fire is produced by friction of two pieces of its wood.

m. (-तिः)
A name of the saint, AGASTYA.
E.
अग्नि fire, i. e. the fire of the stomach, the digestive faculty, and मारुति a name of HANUMĀN; because the saint could digest as well as the monkey: the epithet alludes to a story of his devouring and digesting VĀTĀPI, a demon, who had assumed the form of a sheep.

m. (-खः)
1 A deity.
2 A Brahman.
E.
अग्नि and मुख the mouth; oblations to the gods passing through fire as their mouths.
3 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
4 Marking nut, (Semecarpus anacardium.) (In this sense it is also fem. -खी.)
E.
as before, from its marking like fire.

n. (-णं)
Maintenance of a sacred fire; preserving a fire in a family for perpetuity, which supplies that lighted on occasions of worship.
E.
अग्नि and रक्षण preserving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Maintaining a sacred fire.
E.
अग्नि and रक्षित preserved.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Being without fire, especially a sacred fire.
2 Devoid of appetite.
E.
अग्नि and रहित lost.

m. (-जाः)
An insect of a scarlet color.
E.
अग्नि and रजस् dust or farina.

f. (-हा)
The name of a plant.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Hot, scalding, scorching.
E.
अग्नि and वर्ण quality; of the property of fire.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
1 Tonic, stomachic.
2 Feeding or exciting fire.
E.
अग्नि and वर्द्धक what augments.

n. (-नं)
1 Exciting fire.
2 Improving the appetite.
m. (-नः)
A stomachic or any thing improving the appetite.
E.
अग्नि and बर्द्धन increasing.

m. (-भः)
Resin, pitch.
E.
अग्नि and वल्लभ a friend, from its exciting or befriending fire.

m. (-णः)
A fiery arrow, a rocket.

m. (-णः)
Smoke.
E.
अग्नि and वाह what bears.

m. (-हुः)
Smoke.
E.
अग्नि and वाहु the arm.

m. (-र्पः)
Pain from a boil.
E.
अग्नि and विसर्प a boil.

n. (-जं)
Gold.
E.
अग्नि and वीज seed.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Gold.
E.
अग्नि and वीर्य्य power.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Improved digestion, appetite.
2 Increase of fire.
E.
अग्नि and वृद्धि increase.

m. (-खः)
1 A lamp.
2 An arrow.
3 A fiery arrow, a rocket.
4 The Safflower plant, (Carthamus tinctorius.)
mn. (-खः-खं)
Saffron, the plant and die.
f. (-खा)
1 Flame.
2 A plant. (Gloriosa superba.)
3 A medicinal plant, (Menispermum cordifolium.)
E.
अग्नि and शिखा a crest or flame or splendor.

m. (-रः)
Saffron.
E.
अग्नि and शेखर a crest.

f. (-ष्टुत)
An expiatory sacrifice.
E.
अग्नि and ष्टु to sacrifice, aff. क्विप् with तुक् added.

m. (-मः)
A sacrifice, or rather a series of offerings to fire for five days, to be celebrated in the spring.
E.
अग्नि and स्तोम oblation, burnt-offering.

n. (-ष्ठं)
An iron frying-pan.
mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Placed in or on fire.
E.
अग्नि and ष्ठ what stays or remains, from स्था to stand.

m. pl. (-त्ताः)
Demigods or manes to whom funeral oblations are presented. They are said to be the sons of MARĪCI, and progenitors especially of the gods.
E.
अग्नि, स्व own, and आत्त taken, who receive what is offered them by fire as their own.

m. (-रः)
Any ceremony performed with the consecrated fire.
E.
अग्नि, संस्कार purification.

m. (-खः)
The wind.
E.
अग्नि and सखि friend.

m. (-वः)
Wild safflower.
mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Originating from fire.
E.
अग्नि and सम्भव born.

m. (-यः)
1 A pigeon.
2 The wind.
E.
अग्नि and सहाय a friend.

n. (-रं)
A medicinal application to the eyes, a collyrium from the calx of brass.
E.
अग्नि and सार strength, essence.

n. (-त्रं)
1 Maintenance of a perpetual or sacred fire.
m. (-त्रः)
1 Fire.
2 Ghee.
E.
अग्नि and होत्र oblation with fire, burnt offerings.

m. (-त्री)
One who maintains a perpetual and sacred fire; this is sometimes read अग्निहोतृ. nom. (-ता)
E.
अग्निहोत्र, and णिनि, or हु to sacrifice, तृन् aff.

m. (-ग्नीत्)
A priest who attends the fire.
E.
अग्नि, ईन्ध to excite, क्विप् aff.

m. (-ध्रः)
An officiating priest, whose duty is to attend the fire.
f. (ध्रा)
Exciting the sacrificial fire.
E.
अग्नि and ईन्ध, to light or kindle; and the aff. रन्; the न of इन्ध being dropped.

n. (-ध्रं)
The place where a sacrificial fire is kindled.
E.
अग्नि fire, and इन्ध to kindle; see अग्नीध्र.

n. (-नं)
Exciting a sacrificial fire.
E.
अग्नि and इन्धन kindling, exciting.

m. (-वः)
1 Loss or extinction of the sacred fire.
2 Loss of appetite.
E.
अग्नि, अभाव non-existence.

n. (-स्त्रं)
Fire-arms; in poetry, it is usually applied to a superhuman power over the element of fire, but occasionally indicates, apparently, a rocket.
E.
अग्नि, अस्त्र a weapon.

m. (-रः)
A fire-temple; a chamber or building where the sacred fire is kept.
E.
अग्नि, आगार house.

n. (-नं)
Maintenance of a perpetual and sacred fire.
E.
अग्नि and आधान preserving.

n. (-यं)
Consecration of a perpetual fire.
E.
अग्नि, आधेय placing.

m. (-यः)
1 A place in which consecrated fire is kept.
2 A hole, with compartments of prescribed dimensions and shape, for the several sacred fires.
E.
अग्नि and आलय an asylum.

m. (-तः)
A householder who maintains a perpetual fire; also आहिताग्नि.
E.
अग्नि, आहित preserved; by whom.

m. (-तः)
A fiery meteor, a falling star, a comet.
E.
अग्नि and उत्पात् portent.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Belonging or relating to fire or its deity.
n. (-यं)
1 The name of a city, (Devikote, on the Coromandel Coast.)
2 Blood.
3 Ghee or boiled butter.
m. (-यः)
A name of the saint AGASTI.
f. (-यी)
1 The wife of AGNI.
2 The southeast quarter, of which AGNI is the regent.
E.
अग्नि fire or its deity, ढक् affix which leaves ण्य.
